faq.q: Does Age of Calamity have DLC?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo released an Expansion Pass that adds new content, which is why this extraction includes Special and Deluxe variant tiers.

faq.q: Is the game multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes. It supports local cooperative play for up to two players on a single system.

faq.q: Is this an open-world Zelda game?
faq.a: No. It is a mission-based musou action game, not a free-roaming open-world structure like Breath of the Wild.

faq.q: Can I enjoy it without playing Breath of the Wild?
faq.a: Yes, but familiarity with the Breath of the Wild cast and setting will make many story moments more meaningful.

faq.q: Why are the online account tiers more expensive?
faq.a: That follows the store's pricing structure, while the gameplay content remains tied to the base game and its optional Expansion Pass.

Grinding side content may feel repetitive for completionists

faq.q: Is this the complete Hyrule Warriors package?
faq.a: Yes. Definitive Edition is designed as the most complete Nintendo Switch version of the original Hyrule Warriors content set.

faq.q: Does it support multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes. It supports local cooperative play for up to two players on a single system.

faq.q: How does it differ from Age of Calamity?
faq.a: Definitive Edition is a broader crossover celebration of Zelda history, while Age of Calamity focuses specifically on the Breath of the Wild setting and characters.

faq.q: Is the game story-focused?
faq.a: It has a story mode, but much of its appeal comes from Adventure Mode, unlockables, character growth, and replay-heavy side content.

faq.q: Who is this game best for?
faq.a: It is ideal for players who enjoy musou action, large rosters, and long-term completion goals.

record.title: It Takes Two
record.description: It Takes Two is a co-op-only action-adventure platformer by Hazelight Studios. Two players control Cody and May, a couple transformed into dolls, and must cooperate through highly varied levels where new mechanics appear constantly. On Nintendo Switch it supports same-system co-op, local wireless, and online play, with Friend's Pass allowing a friend to join without owning the full game.

record.worldSummary: Cody and May are transformed into dolls and pushed through a surreal journey shaped by their home, memories, and relationship.

storyChapters.title: A Family in Crisis
storyChapters.body: Cody and May plan to separate, but their daughter Rose wishes they could stay together. The parents are magically transformed into small handmade dolls.

storyChapters.title: Forced to Cooperate
storyChapters.body: Guided by Dr. Hakim, Cody and May must work together through a series of surreal environments where each area gives them complementary abilities.

storyChapters.title: Rebuilding the Bond
storyChapters.body: Their adventure forces them to confront resentment, forgotten passions, and the reasons their relationship broke down as they try to return to their daughter.
